title: Motor hums but no suction
shortDescription: Blower motor energized but not spinning
fullDescription: Kenmore vacuum 'Blower Motor Hum' indicates blower motor energized but not spinning. The vacuum stops or shows reduced performance.

fixSteps.title: Address fault
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, clear inlet; service if motor seized.

fixSteps.title: Replace bag and filters
fixSteps.instruction: Install fresh bag; rinse washable filters.

fixSteps.title: Test
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in and run a short test.

whenToCallPro: If the motor hums but does not spin after the inlet is clear, the motor or capacitor likely needs service.
videoSearchQuery: Kenmore vacuum Blower Motor Hum fix

faq.q: What does 'Blower Motor Hum' mean on a Kenmore?
faq.a: Blower motor energized but not spinning.
Power off, clear inlet; service if motor seized.

faq.q: How often should I replace the bag?
faq.a: Replace the bag when 2/3 full or when the indicator illuminates.
